app_fee.value: No application fee is charged for doctoral studies at Stockholm University.
app_fee.quote: After four years of undergraduate studies (240 credits in Sweden) it is possible to start doctoral studies in order to obtain a Licentiate degree after 2-3 years and continue towards a PhD exam after totally 4-5 years.
